hardinessNote: Tender. Can only go outdoors in summer and is killed by frost; needs about 10°C or more, so grow it as a summer annual.
visual: Cerise-pink flat flowers with a white eye · glossy dark green leaves · flowers all summer
soilWarning: Cold, wet roots cause rot; plant after frost
water: Water when the top of the compost is dry; let it dry between waterings and never leave it standing in water.
prune: No deadheading needed; pinch tips early to bush up if leggy.
toxicity: Highly toxic if eaten: all parts, including the milky sap, contain strong alkaloids. Keep away from children, dogs and cats, and wear gloves when handling.
cvs: Soirée White – pure white · Soirée Pink White Eye – soft pink, white centre · Soirée Light Pink Dark Eye – blush with a dark centre
resilience: Copes with heat and dry spells once established; sulks and rots in cold, wet weather. Pests: aphids, whitefly under cover; root and stem rots in wet compost.
uses: Summer bedding · patio pots · window boxes · hanging baskets
foliage: evergreen; glossy oval dark green leaves (grown as a summer annual in the UK)
pollination: not applicable; grown for flower, not fruit
uncertain: latin: 'Vinca Soirée' assumed to be the bedding vinca Catharanthus roseus Soirée series, not the hardy groundcover Vinca minor/major; the exact label form of the series/colour name is not verified.
